tree.text: The term “dependent”, with respect to a member of a uniformed service, means—

children.text: his unmarried child (including an unmarried dependent stepchild or adopted child) under 21 years of age;
a dependent designated in official records; and
a person determined to be dependent by the Secretary concerned, or his designee.

tree.text: The term “missing status” means the status of a member of a uniformed service who is officially carried or determined to be absent in a status of—

children.text: captured, beleaguered, or besieged by a hostile force; or
detained in a foreign country against his will.
station per diem allowances for not more than 90 days.

The words “In this chapter” are substituted for “For the purpose of this Act”. In clause (1), the words “with respect to a member of a uniformed service” are inserted for clarity.
